library(ggplot2)

```{r}
# OD file mapping matrix, od_xxxx = od_20xx,xx month
# ODT/Bxx_dfs = OD, Train/Bus, 20xx, dfs

# This measure is intended to prevent significant slowdowns caused by directly 
# loading large datasets each time (datasets are typically larger than 
# the available memory).

odT20_dfs <- c(
  "od_2001", "od_2002", "od_2003", "od_2004", "od_2005", "od_2006",
  "od_2007", "od_2008", "od_2009", "od_2010", "od_2011", "od_2012"
)

odB20_dfs <- c(
  "od_2001", "od_2002", "od_2003", "od_2004", "od_2005", "od_2006",
  "od_2007", "od_2008", "od_2009", "od_2010", "od_2011", "od_2012"
)

mode_map <- c("T" = "train", "B" = "bus")

# Going forward, you can simply copy this code chunk as needed. Just change “odT20_dfs” in the for loop (df_name in odT20_dfs). 然后下面的代码list_name <- deparse(substitute(odT20_dfs))里的名字也要改掉（比如说，改成odB20_dfs）
for (df_name in odT20_dfs) {
  list_name <- deparse(substitute(odT20_dfs))
  mode_flag <- substr(list_name, 3, 3)
  
  if (mode_flag == "T") {
    mode_name <- "train"
  } else if (mode_flag == "B") {
    mode_name <- "bus"
  } else {
    stop(paste("Unreadable, the identifier is neither 'T', or 'B'", list_name))
  }
  
  yymm <- substr(df_name, 4, 7)
  yyyymm <- paste0("20", yymm)
  
  file_path <- here("data", "raw", "OD", 
                  paste0("origin_destination_", mode_name, "_", yyyymm, ".csv"))
  
  temp_df <- read_csv_arrow(
    file_path,
    col_select = c(
      "YEAR_MONTH", "DAY_TYPE", "TIME_PER_HOUR",
      "ORIGIN_PT_CODE", "DESTINATION_PT_CODE", "TOTAL_TRIPS"
      )
  )
  
  assign(paste0("od_", mode_name, "_", yyyymm), temp_df)
  
  rm(temp_df)
  gc()
}

for (df_name in odB20_dfs) {
  list_name <- deparse(substitute(odB20_dfs))
  mode_flag <- substr(list_name, 3, 3)
  
  if (mode_flag == "T") {
    mode_name <- "train"
  } else if (mode_flag == "B") {
    mode_name <- "bus"
  } else {
    stop(paste("Unreadable, the identifier is neither 'T', or 'B'", list_name))
  }
  
  yymm <- substr(df_name, 4, 7)
  yyyymm <- paste0("20", yymm)
  
  file_path <- here("data", "raw", "OD", 
                  paste0("origin_destination_", mode_name, "_", yyyymm, ".csv"))
  
  temp_df <- read_csv_arrow(
    file_path,
    col_select = c(
      "YEAR_MONTH", "DAY_TYPE", "TIME_PER_HOUR",
      "ORIGIN_PT_CODE", "DESTINATION_PT_CODE", "TOTAL_TRIPS"
      )
  )
  
  assign(paste0("od_", mode_name, "_", yyyymm), temp_df)
  
  rm(temp_df)
  gc()
}
```
